about.title: Saudi Arabia is going out. We hold the tickets.
about.lede: MyTicket is where people across the Kingdom find live experiences — concerts, sports, festivals, theatre, family days, and places worth the drive — and buy their way in with one tap. Behind the curtain we partner with organizers through our office, and review facility and talent requests from guest accounts.
about.ctaText: The best way to understand MyTicket is to find your next night out.

cards.title: For the people going out
cards.body: Every ticket is a real, verified QR code. Refunds follow rules you can read before you pay. Sold-out shows have honest waitlists and a legitimate resale auction instead of a parking-lot scalper. And your wallet keeps cashback, refunds and resale money in one place — spendable tonight or withdrawable to your bank.

cards.title: For the people making the nights
cards.body: Organizers partner with us through an office contract — we create their account after agreement. Performers and service businesses submit a request from a guest account; our team reviews it, and contact happens outside the platform when there is a fit.

cards.title: How we make money
cards.body: A platform fee on each ticket — always shown as its own line, never hidden in the price — and a commission when a ticket resells at auction. That's it.

cards.title: Where we are
cards.body: Built in Riyadh, operating across all of Saudi Arabia, in Arabic and English. Prices in Saudi Riyals, support every day from 9:00 to 01:00 AST.

tickets.title: Tickets & entry
tickets.blurb: QR codes, gates, names on tickets and what to do if your phone dies.

faqs.q: Where do I find my ticket?
faqs.a: Every ticket sits in My tickets the moment payment clears. Open the event, tap the ticket and the QR code fills the screen — it also works with no signal, so you don't need data at the gate.

faqs.q: Can I send a ticket to someone else?
faqs.a: Yes — open the ticket and choose Transfer to a guest. They get their own QR as soon as they accept, and yours stops working.

faqs.q: Do I need to print anything?
faqs.a: No. The offline QR in the app is enough. You can also add tickets to Apple Wallet or download a PDF if you prefer.

faqs.q: The name on my ticket is wrong
faqs.a: Transfer the seat to the right guest, or contact support before doors if the event requires ID matching.

faqs.q: What time should I arrive?
faqs.a: Doors and show times are on your ticket. Arrive early for security — busy nights can take around 20 minutes at peak.

faqs.q: Can I bring a bag?
faqs.a: Small bags are usually fine. Professional camera gear and large backpacks are often refused — check the event page for the house rules.

refunds.title: Refunds & changes
refunds.blurb: Free windows, transfers, and what happens if a show is cancelled.

faqs.q: When can I get a free refund?
faqs.a: Most events allow a free refund until a date shown on the ticket. After that, transfer or list on the auction.

faqs.q: How long do refunds take?
faqs.a: Approved refunds typically return to the original payment method within 3–7 business days.

faqs.q: What if the event is cancelled?
faqs.a: We'll email you and open an automatic refund. You don't need to file a case unless something looks wrong.

payments.title: Payments & wallet
payments.blurb: Cards, Tabby, cashback, and withdrawing wallet balance.

faqs.q: Which payment methods work?
faqs.a: Visa, Mastercard, mada, Apple Pay, and Tabby on eligible events. Your wallet balance can also pay part or all of an order.

faqs.q: How does cashback work?
faqs.a: Eligible purchases credit your MyTicket wallet after the event. You can spend it on future tickets or withdraw when the balance allows.

faqs.q: Can I split a payment?
faqs.a: Tabby splits eligible orders into instalments. The schedule is shown at checkout and again on the ticket order card.

auction.title: Resale auction
auction.blurb: Listing a seat, bidding, fees, and settlement.

faqs.q: How do I list a ticket?
faqs.a: Open the ticket and choose List for resale. Set your ask within the allowed range and we handle payout when it sells.

faqs.q: Are auction tickets genuine?
faqs.a: Yes — every listing is an original MyTicket seat. The QR transfers to the buyer automatically on settle.

faqs.q: What fees apply?
faqs.a: Seller and buyer fees are shown before you confirm. They come out of the settlement so there are no surprises later.

waitlists.title: Waitlists
waitlists.blurb: Joining a sold-out night and how alerts work.

faqs.q: How do waitlists work?
faqs.a: Join from the event page. If seats free up or a resale lands in range, we'll notify you first.

faqs.q: Do waitlists cost anything?
faqs.a: Joining is free. You're only charged if you buy a ticket when one becomes available.

account.title: Account & security
account.blurb: Sign-in, notifications, and keeping your tickets safe.

faqs.q: How do I turn on two-factor sign-in?
faqs.a: Open Settings → Security and add a phone number or authenticator. We recommend it before any high-value purchase.

faqs.q: I lost access to my email
faqs.a: Contact support with your phone number and a recent order reference so we can verify and restore the account.

business.title: Business requests
business.blurb: Facility and talent requests, and how partnership works.

faqs.q: How do I become a facility or talent?
faqs.a: Sign in as a guest, open Become a business, and submit a request. Our team reviews it in 2–5 working days. Acceptance does not change your login — we contact you outside the platform if needed.

faqs.q: How do I become a business partner?
faqs.a: Organizer accounts are created after an office contract. Contact partnerships from the help or support flow — there is no self-serve apply form.

legal.title: The fine print, readable.
legal.lede: The rules of using MyTicket. Written to be read, not skimmed past.

sections.title: 1 · Who we are
sections.body:
MyTicket is your all-in-one platform for discovering and booking event tickets, wherever they are. We bring together in one place the biggest concerts, theatrical and artistic performances, sports matches, and cultural and entertainment events, making your journey from search to booking easy and enjoyable.
We believe every exceptional moment deserves to be lived without hassle,

sections.title: 2 · Introduction and acceptance of terms
sections.body:
MyTicket ("the Platform", "we") welcomes you. These Terms and Conditions ("the Terms") govern your use of the MyTicket app and website across all its channels: the guest app, the business app, the gate scanner app, and the admin dashboard.
By creating an account or using any of our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these Terms and agree to be bound by them. Your use is also subject to the Privacy Policy set out in section two of this page.

sections.title: 3 · Definitions
sections.body:
The Platform: the MyTicket website and apps across all five of its channels.
Guest: any user who browses events or books tickets.
Organizer: any entity that creates an event and sells its tickets, and may engage talents or service providers
Talent: any artist, performer, exhibitor, or speaker who lists their profile to be booked by organizers.
Ticket: the digital right that grants its holder access to a specific event.
Wallet: the digital balance linked to an account for completing payments

sections.title: 4 · User responsibilities
sections.body:
• Comply with the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia when using the Platform.
• Do not use multiple accounts or automated programs (bots) to obtain tickets unfairly.
• Do not resell tickets outside the auction mechanism approved within the Platform.
• Bear responsibility for any activity carried out through your account, and report any unauthorized use immediately.
• Comply with the entry and conduct rules specific to each event as set by the organizer.
The Platform reserves the right to suspend or close any account, cancel any ticket, or take the necessary legal action in the event of a breach of these Terms.

sections.title: 5 · Event organizer responsibilities
sections.body:
Security and privacy
• Accuracy of the published event data (date, venue, price, age category if applicable).
• Obtaining all licences and regulatory permits required to hold the event.
• Setting the event's entry and refund policy, and notifying the Platform of any change or cancellation as soon as it occurs.
• Complying with the terms of any contract entered into with talents or service providers through the internal booking marketplace.
The Platform acts as a technical intermediary that gives organizers access to talents, and is not a party to the contract concluded between them

sections.title: 6 · Buying and selling tickets
sections.body:
A ticket is a personal, revocable licence to enter the specified event, and does not grant any ownership right. All purchases are final, and a refund is not permitted except in the following cases:
• The event is cancelled by the organizer.
• The event is postponed and the guest does not wish to attend on the new date.
• In accordance with the payment gateway's own refund policy
• As required by the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: 7 · E-wallet and payments
sections.body:
What happens when the account is closed
• Each account has its own digital wallet for managing payments.
• All payments are processed through approved, encrypted payment gateways, without storing full card data.
• E-wallet balance: the e-wallet balance is a balance designated for use within the MyTicket platform only, and may not be redeemed for cash or transferred to a bank account or another payment method, and is considered non-refundable and non-recoverable once deposited into the wallet, subject to any rights determined by law or applicable regulations.
• Wallet balance upon account deletion: the user is responsible for checking their e-wallet balance before requesting account deletion, as deleting the account may result in the loss of the remaining wallet balance, and the user has no right to claim it back after the account deletion process is completed.

sections.title: 8 · Refund and cancellation policy
sections.body:
Refund requests are subject to the event policy set by the organizer, which is shown to the guest before the purchase is completed. If an event is cancelled, the Platform undertakes to return the amount to the guest's wallet or original payment method within a reasonable period
Refunding payments: where a customer is entitled to a refund of the ticket value under MyTicket's approved cancellation and refund policy, the refund is carried out through the approved electronic payment gateway, HyperPay, to the original payment method used to complete the purchase. MyTicket does not retain bank card data.
The time it takes for the refunded amount to appear in the customer's account is subject to the processing and settlement procedures of the payment gateway, the card-issuing bank, and the relevant payment network, and may take several business days. MyTicket is not responsible for any delay resulting from the procedures of banks or payment service providers after the refund request has been carried out by the Platform.

sections.title: 9 · Force majeure
sections.body: Neither MyTicket nor the organizer is responsible for delay or inability to perform obligations arising from circumstances beyond their control, including natural disasters, epidemics, government decisions, or the interruption of technical or communication services, to the extent permitted by the applicable regulations

sections.title: 10 · Ratings and reviews
sections.body:
• A guest who attended an event may rate it after it has ended.
• Reviews must not include offensive or inaccurate content.
• The Platform reserves the right to remove any review that violates these Terms without prior notice.
Ratings are used to rank the appearance of events, talents, and service providers.

sections.title: 11 · Anti-fraud and misuse
sections.body:
• The use of fake accounts or automated programs (bots) to buy tickets in unusual quantities is prohibited.
• Any hacking, reverse engineering, or unauthorized modification of the Platform's systems is prohibited.
• Impersonating a talent, service provider, or organizer is prohibited.
• The Platform reserves the right to freeze any payment or auction suspected of being fraudulent.

sections.title: 12 · Intellectual property
sections.body: All trademarks, designs, and content appearing on the Platform are owned by or licensed to MyTicket. Each organizer and talent retains their rights to the content they upload, while granting the Platform a non-exclusive licence to display it within its services.

sections.title: 13 · Limits of the Platform's liability
sections.body:
The Platform acts as a technical intermediary connecting guests with organizers, talents, and service providers. It is not responsible for organizing the event itself, its quality, or the safety of its venue; this responsibility rests with the organizer
The Platform may display advertisements or offers submitted by organizers, talents, service providers, or other parties. The advertising party is responsible for the accuracy of the information provided and for the products or services it promotes

sections.title: 14 · Suspending accounts and terminating service
sections.body: The Platform may suspend or terminate any account immediately in the event of a breach of these Terms or suspicion of fraudulent activity. The user may close their account at any time through account settings or by contacting support

sections.title: 15 · Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the competent judicial authority in the Kingdom has jurisdiction to settle any dispute

sections.title: 16 · Amending the Terms
sections.body: The Platform reserves the right to amend these Terms at any time, and your continued use of the Platform after the amendments are published constitutes implicit consent to them

sections.title: 17 · Contact us
sections.body: For any inquiry related to these Terms, you can contact the support team through the communication channels available on the Platform.

sections.title: 1 · Introduction
sections.body: MyTicket respects its users' privacy and is committed to protecting their personal data in accordance with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), issued by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA), and in line with relevant international best practices.

sections.title: 2 · Data we collect
sections.body: MyTicket does not collect personal information about a user visiting the site unless the user specifically and knowingly chooses to provide it. Data provided directly by the user: identity data (name, national ID or residency number when required, for identity verification or regulatory compliance), contact data (mobile number, email, address), business account data (commercial registration and event or service details, for organizer and vendor accounts), and payment data (purchase details and wallet balance, without storing full card data). MyTicket does not collect, store, or retain bank card data, including the card number or security code (CVV) — payment data is processed securely and directly through the certified payment gateway, and its handling is governed by that provider's own security and privacy policies. Automatically collected data: device data and approximate location to improve search results, usage data (browsed events and favorited tickets), and cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: 3 · How we use the data
sections.body: Completing purchases, issuing tickets, and managing the wallet; personalizing the experience and showing recommendations relevant to your interests; verifying identity, preventing fraud, and protecting platform security; and sending operational notifications and optional marketing messages you can unsubscribe from at any time.

sections.title: 4 · Sharing data with third parties
sections.body: The platform does not sell users' personal data to any third party. Data is shared with the event organizer when a ticket is purchased, only to the extent necessary to manage attendance.

sections.title: 5 · PDPL compliance
sections.body: Data is only collected to the extent necessary to provide the service, with the purpose of collection clearly defined. Data is not transferred outside the Kingdom except under the controls and exceptions permitted by law.

sections.title: 6 · Cookies
sections.body: The platform uses cookies to remember your preferences, analyze platform performance, and show personalized content. They can be controlled or disabled from browser or app settings, though disabling them may affect some functionality.

sections.title: 7 · Data security
sections.body: Encryption of data in transit and at rest (SSL/TLS); strict access controls limited to authorized staff; periodic security reviews and penetration testing; and an incident response plan that includes notifying users of any breach affecting their data.

sections.title: 8 · Data retention periods
sections.body: We retain user data for as long as the account is active, plus any additional period required to meet regulatory obligations after the account is closed. Once no longer needed, data is deleted or securely anonymized.

sections.title: 9 · User rights
sections.body: You may access the personal data we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your data (subject to regulatory exceptions), withdraw consent to marketing use at any time, and request your data in a machine-readable format where technically possible.

sections.title: 10 · Children's privacy
sections.body: The platform does not target children under the legal age set by regulation and does not knowingly collect their data. If we become aware that a minor's data was collected without parental consent, it will be deleted immediately.

sections.title: 11 · Policy updates
sections.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. Users will be notified of any material change via the platform or email, and continued use after publication constitutes acceptance of the updated version.

sections.title: 12 · Warning
sections.body: MyTicket will never ask you to share your password, verification code, card PIN, or full bank card details via messages, calls, or any unofficial channel. Make sure any communication about your account or tickets comes only through MyTicket's official channels, and don't follow links or make payments based on requests from untrusted parties. MyTicket is not liable for loss or damage resulting from sharing confidential data with parties impersonating MyTicket, without prejudice to any responsibilities imposed by applicable law.

sections.title: 13 · Contact us
sections.body: To exercise any of the rights above, contact MyTicket's data protection team through the support channels on the platform, or by email at privacy@myticket.sa.

sections.title: 1 · Essential cookies
sections.body: These keep you signed in, protect checkout and remember language. The site cannot run without them.

sections.title: 2 · Analytics
sections.body: Optional analytics help us understand discovery and checkout drop-off. They are never sold and can be declined in Settings → Privacy.

sections.title: 3 · Preferences
sections.body: We store UI choices such as language and recently viewed filters so the next visit starts where you left off.

sections.title: 4 · Third parties
sections.body: Payment and map providers may set their own cookies when you use those features. Their policies apply to those cookies.

sections.title: 5 · Managing cookies
sections.body: Change preferences any time in Settings → Privacy, or clear cookies in your browser. Essential cookies will return on the next visit.

sections.title: 6 · Updates
sections.body: When this policy changes in a material way, we note the date at the top of this page.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account and data
deleteAccount.lede: You can delete your MyTicket account and the data tied to it at any time. You don't need the app installed to do this — everything below works from any browser.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Use your MyTicket email or phone and password — the same ones you use in the app.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Go to your account settings and find "Delete account" near the bottom of the page.

steps.title: Confirm with your password
steps.body: You'll be asked to type your password once more to confirm — this is permanent and can't be undone.

deleteAccount.whatGoesBody: Your name, email, phone number, and password are permanently erased, and your profile, saved favorites, notifications, and follows are removed. Completed orders and payment records are kept as required for accounting and legal purposes, but are no longer linked to an active account. Deletion is blocked if you have an upcoming published event you're organizing, a published experience listing, or an unclaimed gift ticket someone sent you — you'll be told exactly which, and can delete once it's resolved.

form.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account. Double check them and try again.
form.walletWarningBody: This will be lost — wallet credit can't be refunded or transferred once your account is deleted.
form.confirmLabel: I understand this permanently deletes my account and can't be undone.
form.successBody: Your account and the data tied to it have been permanently removed.

blockers.has_unclaimed_gift_tickets: Someone sent you a gift ticket you haven't claimed yet. Claim it or let it expire first.
